run_evaluation_loop: run the evaluation function to integrate SDE, compute SOC loss, and return energy visualization
save_molecule_conformations_to_xyz: save generated molecule batches and outputs to XYZ files with atomic symbols and positions
compute_SOC_loss: compute the SOC loss for controls, graph states, and energy outputs using noise schedule
visualize_molecule_conformations: visualize up to 16 molecule conformations from graph states using the atomic number table
evaluate_batch_coverage: evaluate batch recall and coverage metrics for generated states against conformer reference data
